{{define "article"}}

Every setting Rune 0.11.9 reads from rune.toml, grouped the way the file groups them. Each entry gives the factory value, what the setting does in the program's own words, the values it accepts and when a change takes effect. Most have a row in Settings; the rest are changed with rune -config set.

A factory value is what applies until you choose otherwise; your own choices show with rune -config explain <key>. Reset a choice with rune -config reset <key>. Durations and sizes need their units, such as "2m" or "16MiB"; see Configuration file for value formats.

Terminal

Explained in Terminal & background work.

terminal.command_timeout

How long Rune waits for a foreground command before moving it to the background; the command continues running.

Default "120s"Accepts Duration 1s–24h; foreground wait, not kill deadlineTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

terminal.shell

Shell for commands: auto (bash where this machine has it, else /bin/sh; on Windows PowerShell 7, else Windows PowerShell, else cmd) or an absolute executable. Each shell gets a command the way it reads one: POSIX shells -c, PowerShell an encoded script, cmd /C.

Default "auto"Accepts auto, or the absolute path of an installed shell executableTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.term

TERM supplied to tool processes.

Default "xterm-256color"Accepts Documented nonempty text choiceTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.inherit_environment

Inherit all environment variables instead of the development allowlist.

Default falseAccepts true / falseTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.flush_interval

Live output flush interval.

Default "150ms"Accepts Positive duration up to 24hTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.input_wait_delay

How long a command must print nothing before Rune asks the system whether it is blocked waiting for typed input (checked once per quiet spell, on platforms that can tell).

Default "2s"Accepts Positive duration up to 24hTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.drain_after_exit

PTY output drain after exit.

Default "200ms"Accepts Positive duration up to 24hTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.cancel_grace

Termination grace after cancellation.

Default "200ms"Accepts Positive duration up to 24hTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.timeout_grace

Termination grace after timeout.

Default "2s"Accepts Positive duration up to 24hTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.rows

Initial headless terminal rows.

Default 40Accepts Whole number 1–1000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.columns

Initial headless terminal columns.

Default 200Accepts Whole number 1–1000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.max_output_chars

Maximum model-visible command output characters before truncation.

Default 30000Accepts Whole number 100–10000000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.max_output_size

Maximum output a foreground command may print while it runs (held in memory for the live view and its result); past it the command is stopped.

Default "8MiB"Accepts Positive explicit size up to 1GiBTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.max_background_log_size

Largest log a background task may write to disk (streamed, not held in memory). A task whose log passes it is stopped, so a runaway server cannot fill the disk.

Default "100MiB"Accepts Positive explicit size up to 1GiBTakes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.truncate_head_bytes

Beginning output bytes preserved when truncated (1.5 KB).

Default 1536Accepts Whole number 100–1000000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

terminal.truncate_tail_bytes

Ending output bytes preserved when truncated (1.5 KB).

Default 1536Accepts Whole number 100–1000000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

Default 200Accepts Whole number 1–100000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

Maximum total characters returned by find_files.

Default 20000Accepts Whole number 100–10000000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

Maximum matching lines returned.

Default 100Accepts Whole number 1–100000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

search_text.max_line_chars

Maximum characters per matching line before truncation.

Default 2000Accepts Whole number 20–100000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

Maximum model-visible characters for text search results.

Default 30000Accepts Whole number 100–10000000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

scan.max_entries

Most files one find_files or search_text call goes through, however many of them match; past it the search stops there. A limit on work, apart from the result limits (matches).

Default 200000Accepts Whole number 1–10000000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

scan.max_depth

Deepest folder level find_files and search_text descend into; folders below it are not searched.

Default 32Accepts Whole number 1–256Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

scan.regex_steps

Safety fuse for search_text patterns: the most matching steps one line may cost. A pattern that backtracks explosively (such as (a+)+b on a long line) gives up on that line after this many steps, the search goes on, and the model is told which lines it skipped. Ordinary patterns need far fewer.

Default 200000Accepts Whole number 100–10000000Takes effect live — applies on the next read, no restart

network.stream_idle_timeout

Token-saving routers rewrite long tool results into summaries. 'off' (default) sends x-9router-token-saver: off so they keep tool results verbatim; 'on' stays silent and leaves compression to the router.

Default "off"Accepts off / onTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

Classifier

Explained in Classifier policy.

classifier.excluded_tools

Exact tool names excluded from model classifier review only; validation and permissions still apply. Empty array reviews all tools.

Default ["ask_user_questions","track_tasks","web_search","web_fetch","find_files","inspect_file","read_mcp_resource","discover_capabilities","search_text"]Accepts Unique exact tool names; [] is an explicit empty selectionTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

classifier.context_tools

Tool inputs eligible as historical classifier context: the last three matching calls, independent of excluded_tools. Empty array includes none; outputs are never authorization.

Default ["terminal_use","inspect_file","find_files","search_text","create_file","patch_file"]Accepts Unique exact tool names; [] is an explicit empty selectionTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

classifier.enabled

Requires CLASSIFIER.md; always off in Ask.

Default trueAccepts true / falseTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

classifier.model

Omit to inherit the active request provider/model.

Default not setAccepts Configured {provider,id}, or omit to inheritTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

classifier.timeout

Maximum classifier evaluation timeout.

Default "120s"Accepts Positive duration up to 24hTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

classifier.max_output_tokens

Output tokens for a permission decision; a model that must reason gets auxiliary.mandatory_reasoning_output_tokens instead when that is larger.

Default 1024Accepts Whole number 16–10000000Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

classifier.max_evidence_size

Amount of text evidence available for review.

Default "256KiB"Accepts Positive explicit size up to 1GiBTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

classifier.max_policy_size

Maximum bytes per policy file.

Default "64KiB"Accepts Positive explicit size up to 1GiBTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

Auxiliary jobs

Explained in Auxiliary models.

sanitizer.enabled

Extract original user instructions before eligible classifier review by default. Set false to opt out; never runs for human-authorized, excluded, or inactive classifier actions.

Default trueAccepts true / falseTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

sanitizer.model

Omit to inherit the active model. Failure falls back to a distinct active route, then original user sources.

Default not setAccepts Configured {provider,id}, or omit to inheritTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

sanitizer.timeout

Maximum time for one instruction extraction request.

Default "120s"Accepts Positive duration up to 24hTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

sanitizer.max_output_tokens

Output allowance for sourced instruction extraction, bounded by the model's capability.

Default 4096Accepts Whole number 256–10000000Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

sanitizer.max_batch_size

Maximum quoted source-text bytes in one extraction batch. Not a token count or a guarantee that a model accepts the batch; provider payload limits also apply.

Default "64KiB"Accepts Explicit positive byte size; inspect/set/reset through rune -configTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

compact.model

Omit to inherit the active request provider/model.

Default not setAccepts Configured {provider,id}, or omit to inheritTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

compact.max_output_tokens

Output tokens for a history summary; the summariser is told to fit within it.

Default 32768Accepts Whole number 256–10000000Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

compact.max_batch_size

Maximum quoted source/summary text bytes in one compaction batch. Not model tokens; small models may reject it. Original user sources are split, never silently shortened.

Default "128KiB"Accepts Explicit positive byte size; inspect/set/reset through rune -configTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

compact.keep_recent_turns

Turns kept verbatim.

Default 5Accepts Whole number 1–100Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

compact.fallback_context_tokens

Reported input-token threshold for automatic compaction when the model publishes no context window. Unknown usage is never inferred from text or media bytes.

Default 200000Accepts Whole number 1000–10000000Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

compact.message_chars

Unicode characters retained per old assistant/tool-result body. Original user instructions are processed whole, in batches when needed; attachments are separate.

Default 32000Accepts Whole number 100–1000000Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

compact.tool_chars

Unicode characters retained per historical tool call arguments, never one limit shared by an entire call array. Identity and target metadata stay visible.

Default 2000Accepts Whole number 100–1000000Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

title.model

Omit to inherit the active request provider/model.

Default not setAccepts Configured {provider,id}, or omit to inheritTakes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

title.max_output_tokens

Output tokens for a session title; a model that must reason gets auxiliary.mandatory_reasoning_output_tokens on top.

Default 256Accepts Whole number 8–10000000Takes effect applies from the next operation (turn/request); in-flight work finishes on its start snapshot

Maximum title characters.
